channel.title: Bin Wang — Writing
channel.description: Essays and notes by Bin Wang.

item.title: Full Circle: Academic Conferences Will Go Back to Being Insider Gatherings
item.description: Submissions have grown from hundreds to tens of thousands. Conferences no longer disseminate or filter well, and certification is running on inertia. Strip those away and what remains is what a conference was at the start, a group of people meeting.

item.title: Five Years in Singapore: Why I Moved from the United States to Singapore
item.description: How research, career choices, a relationship, immigration, and chance all played a part in my decision to leave the United States for a postdoc in a country I had never visited.

item.title: I've Stopped Optimizing for Academic Papers
item.description: Why I've stopped optimizing for academic papers, and what writing them all those years taught me.

item.title: From MATLAB to Vibe Coding
item.description: My 2026 dev stack is roughly half the size it was two years ago — and the one habit I quietly miss.

item.title: Agent Skills: The Missing Layer
item.description: How Agent Skills help AI stay professional and controllable without blowing up the context window.
